description: Defines template functions and classes for checked arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, etc.) with overflow and range checking, for integral and floating-point types. Implements internal state management for numeric validity and range safety.

classes.name: CheckedNumericState
classes.description: Manages the validity and value of a numeric type, supporting both integer and floating-point types with range and finite checks.

methods.name: CheckedAddImpl
methods.description: Performs checked addition for integral types, returning success status.

methods.name: CheckedSubImpl
methods.description: Performs checked subtraction for integral types, returning success status.

methods.name: CheckedMulImpl
methods.description: Performs checked multiplication for integral types, returning success status.
